definition.name: Interlocked changeover
definition.description: Selects one supply path while separating the alternative.

terminals.label: A
terminals.purpose: First supply active input, selected with AN in position zero. The unselected pair remains separated; coordinated neutral/earthing design is equipment dependent.

terminals.label: B
terminals.purpose: Alternative supply active input, selected with BN in position one. The unselected pair remains separated; coordinated neutral/earthing design is equipment dependent.

terminals.label: OUT
terminals.purpose: Selected active output, joined to A or B through the interlocked model. The unselected pair remains separated; coordinated neutral/earthing design is equipment dependent.

terminals.label: AN
terminals.purpose: First supply return, paired with input A. The unselected pair remains separated; coordinated neutral/earthing design is equipment dependent.

terminals.label: BN
terminals.purpose: Alternative supply return, paired with input B. The unselected pair remains separated; coordinated neutral/earthing design is equipment dependent.

terminals.label: NOUT
terminals.purpose: Selected return output, joined to AN or BN with its matching active input. The unselected pair remains separated; coordinated neutral/earthing design is equipment dependent.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The enclosure supports and separates functional parts. This original teaching model is representative equipment, not a manufacturer drawing.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: The cover limits access to internal connections. Opening it here is a virtual inspection operation.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: Metal clamps establish connections to individual conductors. The circuit engine connects terminal IDs, not the apparent proximity of 3D wires.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: Mounting hardware supports the equipment. Screws, rail clips and glands are modelled separately from electrical connections.

parts.name: Operating mechanism
parts.purpose: The mechanism translates a handle, button, coil or control demand into an operating state.

parts.name: Switching contacts
parts.purpose: Contacts either connect or separate their terminal pairs. Their position is linked to the simulation state, including normally open and normally closed functions.
